name: pixyne
tagline: Quickly review photo folders, safely delete bad and similar shots, fix the shooting dates
blurb: Pixyne application has a simple and intuitive interface: - With a click on photo you can mark to drop it in the trash.
description:
Pixyne application has a simple and intuitive interface:

- With a click on photo you can mark to drop it in the trash.

- In a list view, clicking on a row button opens the corresponding photo.

- In advanced mode you may set or correct the EXIF shooting date, crop and ajust photo.

- Pixyne automaticaly stores the current state of the folder so you can undo changes at any time. This is useful when working with a large number of photos and when you need to close the application in order to continue working later.

- Made changes will not actually be applied until you save.

- When you save changes, you can change all file names to EXIF shooting date format.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
